defects.before: Global button width/display rules made missing-field jump buttons render as separate full-width rows and commas; the missing reason was visually separated from the sticky Next action. The lifted sticky band could also cover the date/time row after the reason was moved.
defects.root_cause: `.trial-missing-jump` did not override the global button width, and the sticky action band had no explicit full-width hint row or mobile bottom placement.
defects.fix: Keep the existing accessible jump buttons inline, add `width:auto`, put the existing required hint inside `.trial-sticky-cta`, allow the hint to occupy a full row, and pin the mobile band to bottom: 0.

defects.before: Booking cards, inbox, and no-payment authority panel kept white/light fills on the black theme; the visual hierarchy and text readability broke.
defects.root_cause: Older Wallet/JSON surfaces used hard-coded light backgrounds and foregrounds outside the newer token pass.
defects.fix: Add dark-mode token overrides for booking cards, selected states, icon/state chips, reservation copy, no-payment authority panel, inbox textarea, and related labels.
defects.regression: codex-mobile-golden-path.spec.ts — dark Wallet card/inbox colors and heading contrast >= 4.5:1

not_defects: Today/Live horizontal overflow at 360/412/430 was already green and remains green.
Map code was not touched; no map-specific product claim is made beyond route/screenshot sanity.
